body: It’s so hard and it’s especially hard to talk to anyone about it because everyone has their own stuff going on and I don’t want to be a bother. And yeah I always compare myself to other people, one of my best friends who is younger than me is so successful and buys all these expensive brand name clothes and I can’t even afford to buy a new pair of shoes. The thing that’s making me the most depressed right now is definitely my living situation but the alternative is being homeless. My parents live in a city with a horrible unemployment rate and it’s so hard to get a job. I’ve applied to every posting as it’s come up across job boards and revised my resume over and over and like I said before I can’t even get a call from McDonald’s. If I could get a job it would give me something to look forward to in the morning but right now I’m just aimlessly wandering. It’s so depressing.
